title: Jazzy Cheese Pizza
description: A flavorful pizza topped with jazzy sauce, melted cheese, and crispy canadian bacon. Perfect for a quick dinner or snack.
instructions: Roll out the pizza dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet or pizza stone.
Spread the jazzy sauce evenly over the dough.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the sauce.
Arrange the sliced canadian bacon on top of the cheese.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic powder.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
